collection.caveat: Registry rows overlap. Zero leads, blocked access, unsearched windows and reviewed evidence are different states. No exhaustive completeness claim.

storeRefresh.scope: Bounded recent samples merged into preserved history; missing periods remain gaps.

global.definition: Global research longlist; includes primary-reviewed profiles, existing cockpit records and candidates. Country links and capital events have separate evidence scopes.

macro.definition: Indicator records, each with its own period and evidence status; not all are current observations.

policy.definition: Policy watch entries; effective, proposed and pending statuses remain separate.

actions.definition: Dated GoTo corporate-action records across the retained history; proposed and completed actions are distinct. Reference entries are not independently verified.

ecosystem.definition: Ownership-register entries across legal entities, associates, fund backing and historical positions. This is not the number of active equity holdings or nodes in a selected network view.

competitors.definition: Unique peer/benchmark IDs: 21 ODS + 44 financial services, less 2 shared entries. Includes partner and regional issuer context; not all are direct rivals.

sentiment.definition: Collected January–October 2026 written-review records, unique within each app/store. Recent samples are not added again. Includes customer, driver and merchant apps; not unique people, official aggregate ratings or complete store history.

deals.definition: Unique companies in the analyst screening pipeline; not signed deals, seller intent or confirmed valuations.

feed.definition: 2,056 curated 2026 records + 6,146 additional archive leads. Archive URLs already in curated records are counted once. 122 curated records are source-reviewed; discovery headlines are not verified events.

research.definition: Distinct report/source entries after duplicate summaries and report links are reconciled. The count includes unreviewed reference entries, not only reviewed PDFs.

validation.browserCheckScope: Data refresh and dated-status reconciliation; no new visual browser walkthrough performed.

scope: Refreshed due October searches and completed active-plan collection, not an exhaustive or fully editorially verified archive. Source limits remain visible.
